capabilities: Strip http/https and www prefixes from displayed links
Strip mobile and amp subdomains from displayed links
Rewrite URL links with custom labels using regex rules
Apply the same formatting to links in note properties
extras: The note content is never changed; only the rendered display of links is affected. Ships with three example custom-label rules, disabled by default. The plugin listing carries an unreviewed-by-Obsidian-staff notice.
motivation: The author wrote it for users who "can't be bothered to use markdown links and still want your notes to look clean."
problem: Raw links like https://www.example.com/... look cluttered unless you hand-write markdown link syntax.
summary: Cleans up bare URLs in reading view by stripping protocol and subdomain prefixes, and can rewrite them with custom regex labels.
